settings.label: Helicopter in Japan (experimental)
settings.info: Puts a copy of the Alps' helicopter into Japan (Alaska always gets one). Off by default: Japan crashed with an earlier copy (2026-11-11) and this one is checked offline only. Takes effect at the next game start; if Japan crashes on loading, switch it off again.

settings.label: Realistic flight
settings.info: Off: arcade (the disc tilts with the stick and springs back, it never tips over). On: a light helicopter (H125): a collective lever that stays where set (~50 % hovers), power limit, torque yaw, vortex ring, blade stall, low g. Momentum and inertia: at speed it carries on, slowing or turning tightly takes a flare and a bank (a J-hook). The Realistic sliders below tune it. Switches in flight too.

settings.label: Realistic: assist
settings.info: Damps the turn rates on top of the rate damping (they die away sooner after the stick is centred, lower top rates). It never levels it: centred, the stick keeps whatever attitude it has. 0: the bare rotor.

settings.label: Realistic: momentum
settings.info: How far speed carries on (the drag forward and sideways). Lower: the air slows it down by itself (more drag, a lower top speed, less J-hook needed). Higher: it glides on further. 100 %: from 200 km/h, stick centred, it loses ~3 % in 4 s.

settings.label: Realistic: rate damping
settings.info: Rotational inertia: how long a roll, pitch or yaw goes on after the stick is centred. Higher: rates die away sooner and top out lower (steadier). Lower: they keep going until countered. 100 %: a roll left alone halves in ~0.65 s at 20 % assist.

settings.label: Realistic: cyclic rate
settings.info: How hard the stick tilts it (pitch and roll authority; it still follows the rotor's load). Also the pilot's when it hovers by itself.

settings.label: Realistic: pedal rate
settings.info: How hard the pedals (right stick, U O) turn the nose.

settings.label: Realistic: stick expo
settings.info: Finer control near the stick's centre (cyclic and pedals), full rate at full deflection. 0: linear; 100: x times |x|.

settings.label: Realistic: torque yaw
settings.info: How much the main rotor's torque yaws the nose when the power changes (more power: left, to be held with the pedals). 0: off.

settings.label: Realistic: collective lever speed
settings.info: How fast RT / LT (Y / H) move the collective lever. 100 %: 2.5 s from the bottom to the top.

settings.label: Realistic: rotor thrust
settings.info: The blades' thrust at the top of the lever: higher hovers lower on the lever and climbs harder (as far as the engine's power reaches). 100 %: a hover at ~50 % low in the Alps, ~75 % at 4800 m.

settings.label: Realistic: engine power
settings.info: The engine's size: the power left over for climbing and pulling g before the rotor droops (OVER-TORQUE and TQ are of this engine's 100 %). Lower: a hover takes most of it, little climb up high.

settings.label: Realistic: thin air up high
settings.info: How much the air thins with height (less thrust and engine power, blade stall earlier). 0: sea-level air everywhere; 100 %: the real air (the Alps reach 4800 m).

settings.label: Realistic: translational lift
settings.info: The extra lift a rotor gets from moving through clean air (~+10 % at 12 m/s; at speed it makes up for the tilted disc). 0: off (more lever needed in forward flight).

settings.label: Realistic: ground effect
settings.info: Extra thrust close to the ground, gone at a rotor's width (10 m). 100 %: up to +12 % on the skids. 0: off.

settings.label: Realistic: vortex ring
settings.info: Sinking slowly straight down under power the rotor sits in its own downwash: lift goes, it shakes, the sink grows; forward speed gets it out. Higher: deeper sooner. 0: off.

settings.label: Realistic: retreating blade stall
settings.info: Near VNE (~270 km/h, earlier with load and up high) the retreating blade stalls: the nose pitches up, it rolls right, lift drops. Higher: stronger and sooner. 0: off (the blades' load limit stays).

settings.label: Realistic: low-g roll
settings.info: Pushed over (the rotor unloaded, LOW G) it rolls right: the tail rotor's thrust above the centre of mass. 0: off (the warning stays).

settings.label: Realistic: tail fin (weathervane)
settings.info: At speed the fin turns the nose into the wind and damps the yaw: the pedals hardly turn the track, turning takes a bank. Lower: flat turns and sideslip come easier. 0: off.

settings.label: Realistic: flare effect
settings.info: At speed, air through the tilted disc loads it: a flare (nose up) pulls g and slows it, a push unloads it. 0: as weak as in a hover (softer flares, less low g from a push); 100 %: from 50 m/s twice a hover's.

settings.label: Arcade: top speed
settings.info: 100 %: ~160 km/h at full tilt (never over 288 km/h).

settings.label: Arcade: turn rate
settings.info: How fast the pedals turn it. 100 %: ~70 degrees a second.

settings.label: Arcade: climb rate
settings.info: Up / down at full RT / LT. 100 %: ~10 m/s.

settings.label: Rotor speed (picture)
settings.info: 100 %: as in the game's own drop scenes (the main rotor 1000 degrees a second).

settings.label: Rotor sound: close / far
settings.info: The two recorded loops are crossfaded by the camera's distance (close: next to it, far: a fly-by). Below 0 the far one is quieter, above 0 the close one; -100 / 100: only one.

settings.label: Hide the game's HUD
settings.info: While flying, the game's own HUD (the activity card, prompts, markers) is hidden; it comes back when you let go. Applies at once.

settings.label: Helicopter HUD
settings.info: A small flight display at the bottom: attitude, heading, speed, vertical speed, height above the sea and the ground; realistic adds the collective and torque bars, the g load and the warnings.

settings.label: Helicopter HUD: size
settings.info: Grows or shrinks about its bottom centre.
